title: THE HIRE TAB GREYS WHAT YOU CANNOT AFFORD
why: Following v21.46 in the shop: on the hire tab every fee was the same amber, whatever you hold. A fee you cannot pay now reads grey there too, so both tabs say at a glance what you can afford.
now: The hire tab shows fees you cannot afford in grey, as the shop does.

edits.replacement: cell.className='vcell'+(i===P._mercSel?' on':'')+((cost===null)?' locked':'')+((cost!==null&&P.merc!==ID.id&&cost>(P.credits||0))?' poor':'');   // v16.xx: a hire you cannot pay for reads grey, as the shop does (v21.46)
